enumDescriptions: Use the Colcoor backend: collaboration, side chat, and sign-in.
Fully offline single-user storage under the workspace .colcoor folder (no sign-in, no collaboration).
colcoor.storageMode.description: Where conversations are stored. remote: Colcoor backend (default). local: offline single-user files under the workspace .colcoor folder. Reload the window (Developer: Reload Window) after changing this.

colcoor.backendBaseUrl.description: API origin only (no path, no trailing slash). Defaults to https://api.colcoor.com. For self-managed GCP deployments, set this to your load balancer IP or URL.

enumDescriptions: Use Anthropic APIs directly: ask mode via the Messages API, plan/agent via the Claude Agent SDK. Bring your own Anthropic API key.
Legacy: run the Cursor headless CLI (`agent -p`). Requires a Cursor account and the `agent` binary on PATH.
colcoor.provider.description: Which supplier runs the assistant. anthropic (default): direct Anthropic APIs with your own key, no Cursor account. cursor: legacy Cursor CLI backend.

colcoor.askModel.description: Model id for Ask mode (Anthropic Messages API). Ignored when colcoor.provider is cursor.

colcoor.agentModel.description: Model id for Plan/Agent mode (Claude Agent SDK). Ignored when colcoor.provider is cursor.

colcoor.promptCacheTtl.description: Anthropic prompt cache duration for the shared transcript prefix. 1h keeps cache hits warm across slow branching at a higher write cost; 5m is cheaper for rapid back-to-back turns.

colcoor.agentMode.description: How to run the main-thread assistant after your message is saved. auto/headless: run the configured provider. stub: placeholder reply only (offline / CI).

colcoor.agentExecutable.description: [legacy Cursor CLI] Executable name or absolute path for Cursor headless `agent` (see https://cursor.com/docs/cli/headless). Only used when colcoor.provider is cursor. Colcoor prepends ~/.local/bin (and a few common dirs) to PATH because the editor often does not load ~/.bashrc; use an absolute path if yours is elsewhere.

colcoor.agentTimeoutMs.description: Max time in milliseconds to wait for one `agent -p` run (default 5 minutes).

colcoor.agentOutputFormat.description: [legacy Cursor CLI] How Cursor `agent -p` prints stdout (see https://cursor.com/docs/cli/reference/output-format). Only used when colcoor.provider is cursor. stream-json-partial: NDJSON + --stream-partial-output (fine-grained UI streaming). stream-json: NDJSON without partial deltas. text: final answer only (works on older CLI; minimal streaming).

colcoor.agentPromptShellApproval.description: [legacy Cursor CLI] When the Cursor CLI rejects a tool call (shell, read, write, web fetch, MCP, etc.), show a Colcoor prompt with Skip or Add to allowlist. Only used when colcoor.provider is cursor. Add to allowlist updates your ~/.cursor/cli-config.json for future runs; Run executes a rejected shell command once and resumes the agent with the output; Skip resumes without running the tool.

colcoor.includeWorkspaceHintsInAgentProm.description: When true, append optional workspace context (active file path, non-empty selection, git diff) after the authoritative transcript for each `agent -p` run only (see docs/principles.md). Does not change persisted events.

colcoor.promptForCursorCliOnActivate.description: [legacy Cursor CLI] If the Cursor CLI (`agent`) is not on PATH, show a setup hint a few seconds after load (only when colcoor.provider is cursor and agent mode is not stub). Colcoor cannot bundle the CLI; use Colcoor: Set up Cursor CLI or the official installer.

colcoor.conversationAgentTraceOpen.description: When true, the Cursor CLI trace block under each assistant message starts expanded; when false, it starts collapsed.

colcoor.sideChatNotificationsEnabled.description: Show VS Code notifications for new side-chat messages when the conversation tab is hidden or the side-chat column is closed.

colcoor.sideChatMentionNotificationsEnab.description: When enabled, side-chat messages containing @mentions use mention-priority notification wording.

colcoor.sideChatSoundEnabled.description: Play a short sound cue for new incoming side-chat messages in the open conversation, even when that tab is not focused.

colcoor.sideChatMentionSoundEnabled.description: Use a distinct mention sound pattern when a side-chat message mentions your profile handle.

colcoor.sideChatSoundVolume.markdownDescription: Volume percentage for side-chat sound cues (0 = muted, 100 = full level). Use [Test side chat sound…](command:colcoor.testSideChatSound) to preview.
